Uganda
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in London, United Kingdom or bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Roma
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Embassy of Republic of Uganda, Rim:
Address: Viale Giulio Cesare 71, Piano 2, Scala A/B, 00192 RomaTel: +39 06 3225220 +39 06 3207232Fax: +39 06 3213688Web: www.embassyofuganda.itBusiness hours: Monday - Friday, 09,00 to 16,00.
Citizens of the Republic of Uganda are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
